protocolVersion.$comment: Maximum equals the latest Identity protocol version

type.$comment: Identity Credit Withdrawal Transition is type 6

identityId.$comment: Identity with the specified ID must exist

coreFeePerByte.description: Fee per byte for the Core chain withdrawal transaction

pooling.description: Withdrawal pooling option. 0 - Standard, 1 - Never, 2 - If Available

outputScript.description: Core chain output script specifying the destination address

nonce.description: Unique value to prevent replay attacks

userFeeIncrease.description: Optional fee increase multiplier to prioritize the state transition

signaturePublicKeyId.description: The ID of public key used to sign the state transition
signaturePublicKeyId.$comment: Must be a key with TRANSFER purpose (purpose 3)

signature.description: Cryptographic signature of the state transition
